title: Diacritics are letters
description_en: Preserve č ř ů ď ť ě and uppercase marks; do not replace ď/ť with d/t plus apostrophe. Verify glyph clearance in the actual font.
requirement: Preserve č ř ů ď ť ě and uppercase marks; do not replace ď/ť with d/t plus apostrophe. Verify glyph clearance in the actual font.

title: Normalization is derived only
description_en: Keep original NFC/NFD byte identity. Never apply NFKC to manuscripts or turn NBSP into ordinary spaces silently.
requirement: Keep original NFC/NFD byte identity. Never apply NFKC to manuscripts or turn NBSP into ordinary spaces silently.

title: One-letter word binding
description_en: Consider k s v z o u a i with the following Czech phrase; check grammatical role, quotation language and code before proposing NBSP. Never insert it automatically.
requirement: Consider k s v z o u a i with the following Czech phrase; check grammatical role, quotation language and code before proposing NBSP. Never insert it automatically.

title: Bound semantic units
description_en: Review quantity/unit, initials/name and date bindings; avoid an unbreakable whole address or sentence on narrow screens.
requirement: Review quantity/unit, initials/name and date bindings; avoid an unbreakable whole address or sentence on narrow screens.

title: Czech hyphenation context
description_en: Use Czech dictionaries with recorded edition and morphological boundaries. A CSS hyphens declaration alone is not proof of correct breaks.
requirement: Use Czech dictionaries with recorded edition and morphological boundaries. A CSS hyphens declaration alone is not proof of correct breaks.

title: Czech quotation
description_en: Review „…“ and nested ‚…‘ in local-language context; punctuation position depends on whether a full sentence or fragment is quoted.
requirement: Review „…“ and nested ‚…‘ in local-language context; punctuation position depends on whether a full sentence or fragment is quoted.

title: Hyphen dash minus
description_en: Preserve lexical hyphen, en dash ranges and mathematical minus as distinct roles. No blanket replacement.
requirement: Preserve lexical hyphen, en dash ranges and mathematical minus as distinct roles. No blanket replacement.

title: Percent depends on meaning
description_en: Distinguish quantity 30 % from adjectival 30% sleva and quantity 24 h from adjectival 24h; never infer grammar from a percent formatter.
requirement: Distinguish quantity 30 % from adjectival 30% sleva and quantity 24 h from adjectival 24h; never infer grammar from a percent formatter.

title: Temperature and angle
description_en: Distinguish 18 °C from 45°; keep °C together without applying angle spacing rules to temperature.
requirement: Distinguish 18 °C from 45°; keep °C together without applying angle spacing rules to temperature.

title: Dates and time variants
description_en: Record document convention for 20. 10. 2026, business numeric dates, 8.05 or 8:05; preserve values and accepted variants.
requirement: Record document convention for 20. 10. 2026, business numeric dates, 8.05 or 8:05; preserve values and accepted variants.

title: Inflection and information order
description_en: Do not reorder words for fit or concatenate dictionary forms; Czech cases, numerals and clitics require contextual editorial review.
requirement: Do not reorder words for fit or concatenate dictionary forms; Czech cases, numerals and clitics require contextual editorial review.

title: Names and casing
description_en: Preserve official names and diacritics. Do not impose English Title Case; all-caps display is a separate authorized style.
requirement: Preserve official names and diacritics. Do not impose English Title Case; all-caps display is a separate authorized style.

title: Voice and register
description_en: Distinguish standard colloquial, regional and nonstandard voice; change ty/vy or shorten copy only on explicit request.
requirement: Distinguish standard colloquial, regional and nonstandard voice; change ty/vy or shorten copy only on explicit request.

title: Font and medium evidence
description_en: Choose actual font, weight, size and medium; measure accents, fallback, line breaks and licenses rather than copying a universal heading ratio.
requirement: Choose actual font, weight, size and medium; measure accents, fallback, line breaks and licenses rather than copying a universal heading ratio.
